knownLimitations.limitation: The /api/edit-game endpoint trims history to the last 20 messages (each capped at 500 chars). If a user references something from before message N-20, Claude will not have that context. This is a product-level limitation: "revert the change you made earlier" fails silently if the referenced edit is outside the window.
knownLimitations.impact: Users making many edits in a single session may find Claude unable to reference early edits.
knownLimitations.recommendation: Consider persisting a rolling summary message rather than raw history, or raising the window for paid tiers.

knownLimitations.limitation: The 6-asset cap from the initial generation prompt is not enforced server-side during edits. An edit can add up to 3 new assets on top of an existing 6, resulting in 9 total assets in the manifest.
knownLimitations.impact: Games can accumulate more than 6 Meshy models over multiple edits, increasing load times.
knownLimitations.recommendation: Add a server-side check: if existingIds.length + pendingItems.length > 6, trim pendingItems to fit.

knownLimitations.area: Server-side hot-reload entity state on reload
knownLimitations.limitation: Player health and score are preserved across hot-reloads; entity world is fully reset. This means in-progress game state (enemy positions, collected items, score multipliers stored in Lua locals) is lost on every edit.
knownLimitations.impact: Players in active sessions see a full scene reset when the game creator makes an edit.
knownLimitations.recommendation: Documented and expected behavior. Consider adding a client-side "game updated" banner.

fixesApplied.description: hot_reload: removed savedEntities restoration — OnStart now rebuilds entities from scratch, eliminating ghost objects.
fixesApplied.bug: Old entity map was preserved and then _callbacks.start() added new entities on top, leaving uncontrolled ghosts.

fixesApplied.description: hot_reload: new engine created before old engine closed. On script error, new engine is discarded and previous state is fully restored (lua, world, pending queues).
fixesApplied.bug: Lua engine was closed before validating new script. A syntax error left the game with no engine and no entities.
